goal: Ship Bronze v0.1.0 as a split macOS release: named Apple Silicon and Intel packages, not an arm64-only build and not a silent universal2 blob. The operator explicitly asked for a separate Intel build and thereby accepted ADR-002.
outcome: https://github.com/NxT-Solutions/Bronze/releases/tag/v0.1.0 has bronze-macos-arm64.pkg and bronze-macos-x86_64.pkg. release.yml reuses tag v0.1.0, does not push main, builds on macos-15 (Swift 6) for aarch64-apple-darwin and on macos-15-intel for x86_64-apple-darwin, and sets MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0 plus CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0. publish-homebrew.yml is green when skipped (no secrets in if:), and the first cask uses on_arm / on_intel once both pkgs exist. Tap NxT-Solutions/homebrew-nxt-solutions-packages is not protected by required PRs. ADR-002 is Accepted with that rationale. ADR-009 and ADR-018 stay Proposed. QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS stays parked. No notarization or WCAG claim.

requirements.statement: ADR-002 is Accepted because the operator explicitly asked for a separate Intel (x86_64) build. Record that rationale in docs/18-adrs.md. This is not a silent accept. Minimum is macOS 14.0. Ship two named artifacts, not universal2. ADR-009 and ADR-018 stay Proposed.

release.yml reuses existing tag v0.1.0 and must not push main. Build on macos-15 so BronzeNative swift-tools-version 6.0 compiles. Matrix or second job: aarch64-apple-darwin and x86_64-apple-darwin. Prefer macos-15-intel for the Intel job. Keep MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0 and CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=14.0. Artifacts are bronze-macos-arm64.pkg and bronze-macos-x86_64.pkg. Never claim notarization.

publish-homebrew.yml must not use secrets in job/step if: (that marks skipped-on-push red). Homebrew Casks/bronze.rb supports both arches with on_arm / on_intel once both pkgs exist. Tap is NxT-Solutions/homebrew-nxt-solutions-packages. Do not protect the tap with required PRs. Push the cask to the tap default branch.

Rust records the cargo target arch (arm64 or x86_64), not a hardcoded arm64-only contract. Swift build in bronze-desktop build.rs passes --arch for the cargo target so Intel links BronzeNative. Do not start QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS. Do not claim WCAG, VoiceOver, or notarization.

A Release dispatch with version=0.1.0 reuses tag v0.1.0, does not push main, and publishes bronze-macos-arm64.pkg and bronze-macos-x86_64.pkg on https://github.com/NxT-Solutions/Bronze/releases/tag/v0.1.0.

docs/18-adrs.md marks ADR-002 Accepted and states the operator asked for a separate Intel build. Homebrew cask generation includes on_arm and on_intel. skipped Homebrew publish is not a red required check.
